question: In what state does one stand after all activity has dissolved in the union of great venture?
premises: All activity dissolves in the union of great venture.
One becomes full in the heaped flood of self-rays.
Abiding there, one stands in that state.
inference: One whose activities have dissolved in the union of great venture becomes full in the heaped flood of self-rays and stands there.
uncertainties: The great venture denotes a subtle yogic union rather than an outward effort.
plain_english: One whose activities have all dissolved in the union of great venture becomes full in the heaped flood of self-rays and stands there.
